• Diversification within semiconductor space (CPU/AI accelerators vs. Micron's memory)

• Recent 15% decline may indicate broader sector weakness
• Portfolio concentration risk in technology sector already elevated
• Competition from NVIDIA, Intel, and custom silicon (Google TPUs)

I recommend further monitoring AMD's volume patterns and earnings trajectory before initiating a position, and suggest capping any new AMD allocation at 10-15% of total portfolio value to maintain appropriate diversification.

Please let me know if you'd like me to prepare a deeper technical analysis or model various position sizing scenarios.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
